## Scenario

Describe the decision situation in human terms.

## Candidate actions or labels

List the possible next actions, labels, or decisions.

## Expected shape

Should this look stable, binary ambiguous, diffuse, boundary-sensitive, or
drifting?

## Baseline comparison

Would entropy, margin, or simple drift already be enough here?
